info.title: API.SH: Dailymotion
info.description: The Dailymotion API from API.SH: public Dailymotion data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Videos of a Dailymotion category (news, sport, music, tech...), newest or most viewed first, optionally from one country; without `channel`, the list of categories. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dailymotion-channel

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Category id or dailymotion.com/channel link; empty lists categories.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: recent (default), relevance, visited, visited-today, visited-week, visited-month, trending, old.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Only videos from this country (two letters).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dailymotion-playlist

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Playlist id (x...) or a dailymotion.com/playlist URL.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Videos per page, 1-100 (default 20; page x limit at most 1000).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Dailymotion video: title, description, duration, dates, total/daily/weekly/monthly views, likes, bookmarks, channel, country, language, tags, thumbnails, owner (followers, verified), embed URL, size, available formats, live status, filmstrip/sprite images, the HLS manifest URL and subtitles. With `related=true`, also `related`: the videos Dailymotion lists as related, in the same shape as search results.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dailymotion-video

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Video id (x...) or a dailymotion.com / dai.ly URL.

parameters.name: related
parameters.description: true: also return `related` (related videos). Off by default.

parameters.name: related_limit
parameters.description: How many related videos with related=true, 1-100 (default 20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
